name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and cysteine palmitoylation
rationale: All members concern N-terminal/cysteine palmitoylation and autoproteolysis that mature Hedgehog ligand for release, unlike Hh pathway signalling (C1), RAS C-terminal processing (C2, C3) or Wnt lipidation (C4).

name: PTEN control of PI3K-AKT signalling
rationale: Members cover PTEN stability, localization and ceRNA/lncRNA control plus AKT output and its negative regulation, whereas confusables centre on nuclear phosphoinositide and pyrophosphate synthesis or PAK-2p34.

core: Renal fluid and blood pressure homeostasis
name: Vasopressin and renin-angiotensin control of renal fluid balance
rationale: Members span vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption, renin-angiotensin and renal sodium/blood pressure regulation, distinguishing them from osmotic chloride-cotransporter themes (C1, C3) and vascular tone/endothelin themes (C2, C4).

name: Fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation regulation
rationale: Members concern fibrin clot dissolution, plasminogen activation and circulating fibrinogen, distinct from the coagulation cascade (C4), contact activation (C3), VWF (C2) and matrix proteolysis (C1).

name: NOD1/2 bacterial sensing driving TAK1-JNK/p38 activation
rationale: Members cover peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide sensing by NOD1/2 and ALPK1 with TAK1-mediated stress kinase activation, distinguishing them from TLR/IKK-NF-kB (C3), TLR2/4 lipid sensing (C4) and JNK-only regulation (C2).

name: Germ cell development and oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: Members concern germ cell migration, proliferation and meiotic entry, oocyte maturation and testicular somatic support cells, unlike sex determination (C1) or follicle/gonadotropin endocrinology (C2-C4).

name: SLC26 family exchange of sulfate, oxalate and iodide
rationale: All members concern SLC26 anion exchangers and their disorders, distinct from cation-chloride cotransporters, iodide/thyroid hormone handling, bicarbonate transporters and CFTR.

qualifier: myeloid, signalling and keratinocyte target genes
name: RUNX1 transcriptional control of myeloid, signalling and keratinocyte genes
rationale: All members are RUNX-family (mainly RUNX1) control of target-gene programmes; the keratinocyte, WNT and estrogen-receptor targets separate it from RUNX1 megakaryocyte/expression (C3) and granulopoiesis (C4) themes.

name: FLT3 mutants resistant to gilteritinib, quizartinib, midostaurin, sunitinib, pexidartinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to specific kinase inhibitors; the named drug set distinguishes it from sibling FLT3-resistance sets (C2-C4) and KIT/PDGFR resistance (C1).

qualifier: nucleobase and nucleoside salvage to IMP/GMP
name: Purine nucleobase and nucleoside salvage
rationale: All members concern HPRT1-type salvage of guanine/hypoxanthine to IMP and GMP, as opposed to purine catabolism in all confusables.

name: Cadherin processing, degradation and cell-cell adhesion
rationale: Members concern cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) trafficking, cleavage and degradation within cell-cell adhesion, unlike adherens/apical junction assembly (C1-C3) or integrin/hemidesmosome adhesion (C4).

name: Mannose and amino-sugar metabolism with N-glycan trimming
rationale: Members cover mannose, fructose-6-phosphate, GlcNAc and sialic acid catabolism together with N-glycan glucosidase/mannosidase processing (MOGS, MAN1B1), which separates it from UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid synthesis themes.

name: Dorsoventral spinal cord patterning and interneuron fate specification
rationale: All members concern dorsoventral neural tube patterning and spinal interneuron specification, distinct from floor plate/axial mesoderm (C1, C3) and brain or glial differentiation (C2, C4).

name: Deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis and pyrimidine salvage
rationale: Members concern dNTP/dNMP synthesis (dTTP, dAMP) and pyrimidine nucleoside salvage, unlike de novo pyrimidine synthesis and deoxyribonucleotide catabolism in the confusables.

name: Translation termination, stalled ribosome rescue and nonsense-mediated decay
rationale: Members cover termination, NMD, no-go/non-stop decay and RQC on the ribosome, unlike nuclear exosome decay (C1), initiation (C2), degron-rule proteolysis (C3) or 3'-end processing (C4).

name: IL-2, IL-10 and IL-12 production and T cell activation
rationale: Members regulate IL-2, IL-10 and IL-12 output, Treg differentiation and activated T cell proliferation, unlike broad T-cell suppression (C2), inflammatory cytokine restraint (C3) or IL-10-family receptor signalling (C4).

qualifier: FLT3 and PDGFR mutants to STAT5
name: Oncogenic FLT3 and PDGFRA/B signalling to STAT5
rationale: Members cover FLT3 and PDGFRA/B mutant and fusion signalling, STAT5 activation and CBL-mediated negative regulation, distinct from ALK/FGFR resistance (C1) and EPO/interleukin STAT5 signalling (C2-C4).

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion and synapse assembly with receptor clustering
rationale: Members concern neurexin-neuroligin and other synaptic adhesion organizing pre/postsynaptic assembly and AMPA/NMDA/GABA receptor clustering, unlike dendritic spine and actin plasticity confusables.

qualifier: lymph node and S1P receptor signalling
name: Lymphocyte homing to lymph nodes and S1P receptor signalling
rationale: Members cover lymphocyte and dendritic cell migration into lymphoid organs, lymph node development and S1P/PLC/Cdc42 signalling, unlike chemokine-receptor binding (C1, C2) or gut-associated lymphoid tissue (C3, C4).

name: Exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay and translation-coupled mRNA surveillance
rationale: Members combine 3'-5' exosome decay of nuclear RNAs with NMD, no-go/non-stop decay and RQC, unlike 3'-end processing and 5'-3' decay (C1), splicing/export (C3) or tRNA processing (C4).

name: Centrosome organization, microtubule nucleation and spindle positioning
rationale: Members concern centrosome/centriole control, MTOC nucleation, spindle orientation and cilium assembly/disassembly, unlike ciliary trafficking (C1, C4) and mitotic progression/cytokinesis (C2, C3).

name: G2/M checkpoint and cell-cycle gene expression
rationale: Members concern G2 phase and the G2/M (Chk1/Chk2) checkpoint plus cell-cycle expression modules, unlike stimulated T-cell division (C1), G1/S E2F (C3) or cyclin/PLK mitotic entry (C2, C4).

qualifier: targeting, insertion, folding and quality control
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion, folding and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored targeting into the ER, folding, retention and ERAD/quality control, unlike COPI/COPII vesicle traffic (C1-C3) or UPR transcriptional responses (C4).

name: Lipoxygenase synthesis of HETEs, hepoxilins and lipoxins
rationale: All members concern 5/12/15-lipoxygenase products of arachidonate, unlike leukotriene catabolism, cytochrome P450 eicosanoids or omega-3 resolvin biosynthesis.

name: CFTR epithelial anion secretion and pH-sensing ion channels
rationale: Members concern CFTR-dependent anion/water transport and pH-sensing TRP/TALK channels; the pH channels separate it from epithelial polarity/secretion confusables and CFTR from sour-taste (C3).
